newsitem.title: MALAWI: Malawian police kill one, arrest 13 with marijuana.
newsitem.headline: Malawian police kill one, arrest 13 with marijuana.

text.p: Police in Malawi shot dead a suspected drug trafficker, arrested 13 people and seized more than 10 tonnes of marijuana with a street value of $400,000 on Friday, the biggest haul in the country's history.

Police spokesman George Namakupula told Reuters police had shot one of the suspects when he tried to escape after their truck was stopped at a roadblock in the Nkhotakota district of central Malawi. The man died an hour later in hospital.

"We saw it (the truck) was loaded with bags covered by a tarpaulin. After sniffing at the bags, I discovered they contained chamba (marijuana)," Namakupula said. The marijuana was concealed in 118 bags, he added.
Namakupula said the 13 suspects who were arrested on the scene would be arraigned soon in court.

Two months ago, students in the same district asked the authorities to legalise Malawi marijuana -- which is in high demand in neighbouring countries -- in order to help boost the country's foreign exchange income.
